At 11.30 a.m. 16-2-34, D.S.I. P. Bongiardini and
C.D.S. 39, attached to the French Police, came to the
station and requested assistance to arrest one, Tsha
Chuen Doo (蔡徒) residing at 24 Chuen Loh Tshung (全樂村)
off Avenue Edward VII, (see off. 3 diary 1) on the
authority of warrant of arrest number 1362, issued by
Judge Dzien of the Shanghai 1st Special District Court
at the request of the Shanghai 2nd Special district Court.

D.S. Harvey and C.D.C. 265 accompanied the French
detectives to the above address and found the wanted man
to be out. D.S.I. Bongiardini requested that the
warrant be kept on file at this station and he would again
call for assistance to execute same before 22-2-34, the
date on which the validity of the warrant expires.
'Tsha' now wanted for "Intimidation & assault."

1934年2月16日上午11时30分，隶属于法国警察局的警探长 P. Bongiardini 和副警探 39号来到本警局，请求协助逮捕居住在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）全乐村24号的蔡徒（Tsha Chuen Doo）（见警官日志第1册第3页），依据的是上海第一特区地方法院应上海第二特区地方法院请求，由 Dzien 法官签发的第1362号逮捕令。

警探长 Harvey 和华人副警探 265号陪同法国警探前往上述地址，发现被通缉者不在家。警探长 Bongiardini 要求将逮捕令留存于本警局备案，他将在1934年2月22日（即逮捕令有效期届满之日）前再次请求协助执行该令。
“蔡”目前因“恐吓及袭击”罪被通缉。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2. Special Branch
REPORT
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
5675
Date February 7th. 1934
Subject (in full) Return for cancellation of Warrants Nos. 1300 and 1301.
Made by D. S. Jones Forwarded by D. J. Everest.

At about 5 p.m. on February 6, 1934, members of the Special
Branch accompanied by detectives from Chengtu Road Station and
renresentatives from the Public Safety Bureau visited No. 24
Chuen Loh Tshung(釐樂邨), Avenue Edward VII, in order to execute
Warrant No. 1300 for the arrest of one Tsha Chuen Doo (蔡鈞徒),
wanted by the Public Safety Bureau for being a communist, and
Warrant No. 1301, also issued at the request of the Bureau,
authorising search of the room occupied by Tsha Chuen Doo at the
above address. The latter was absent when the party of Police
visited the premises and had not returned when the search was
terminated and the party took its departure. Although a
thorough search was made of the room nothing of a communistic
nature was found. It was not considered advisable to force
open drawers of a desk which were locked nor yet a safe in the
corner of the room which was also locked.
A Chinese detective was left on the premises to arrest the
wanted man should he put in an appearance later.
At 11 a.m. today a telephone enquiry was received by this
office from the Public Safety Bureau asking what was the result
of the watch maintained at the above premises. On being
informed that no arrest had been made so far, the Public Safety
Bureau official made it clear that the Bureau no longer desired
the watch to be maintained.
At 2.30 p.m. on February 7 instructions were given by the
Senior Detective i/c Chengtu Road Station for the discontinuance
of the watch at No. 24 Chuen Loh Tshung, Avenue Edward VII.
In view of the foregoing the two warrants are returned
herewith for cancellation.
The morning before this raid was carried out (February 5)

5675
日期 1934年2月7日
主题（全称） 关于撤销第1300号和1301号逮捕令的回执。
呈报人：警探长 Jones 转呈人：副总监 Everest。

1934年2月6日下午5时许，特别支部成员在成都路警局警探的陪同下，会同公共安全局代表，前往爱多亚路釐樂邨（Chuen Loh Tshung）24号，以执行第1300号逮捕令，逮捕被公共安全局以共产党嫌疑通缉的蔡鈞徒（Tsha Chuen Doo）；以及执行同样应该局请求签发的第1301号搜查令，授权搜查蔡鈞徒在上述地址居住的房间。警方人员到达该处时，此人不在，直至搜查结束、警方人员离开时仍未返回。虽然对房间进行了彻底搜查，但未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。鉴于书桌抽屉和房间角落的保险箱均上了锁，认为不宜强行打开。
一名华人警探被留在该处，以便在该通缉犯随后出现时将其逮捕。
今天上午11时，本办公室接到公共安全局的电话查询，询问在上述地点监视的结果如何。当得知迄今尚未实施逮捕后，公共安全局官员明确表示，该局不再希望继续维持监视。
2月7日下午2时30分，成都路警局高级警探负责人下达指令，停止对爱多亚路釐樂邨24号的监视。
鉴于上述情况，现将两份逮捕令随文退回，予以撤销。
在此次突袭行动的前一天上午（2月5日）

Sir,
At 5pm. on 6/2/34, D.J. Jones, attached to Special Branch, and representatives of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, attended this station with warrant No.1300 for the arrest of one Tsha Chuen Doo (蔡德) residing at No. 24 Chuen Loh Tshung, venue Edward Vll, and warrant No.1301 to search this man's home and seize certain communistic literature. Both warrants were issued by Judge Feng at the request of The Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, the arrest warrant describing him as "wanted for being a communist".
Assistance was given by D.J. Kennedy, but the wanted man was absent from home, and a search of his room failed to reveal any communistic literature. Chinese detective was left on the premises until 3pm. 7/2/34, when Special Branch withdrew the warrants from the station and asked that the detective be withdrawn.
The arrest of this person was also requested by Detective Kulonay, French Police, at 9-35am on 5/2/34, for the assault of one Jong Moong Yoong in the French Concession on 30/1/34. The assault was trivial and the detective was advised to obtain a warrant, but has not returned.

1934年2月6日下午5时，隶属特别支部的警探 Jones 和上海公共安全局代表持第1300号逮捕令来到本警局，该令用于逮捕居住在爱多亚路全乐村24号的蔡德（Tsha Chuen Doo）；以及持第1301号搜查令，用于搜查此人家宅并扣押某些共产主义文献。两份令状均由冯法官应上海公共安全局请求签发，逮捕令描述其为“因共产党嫌疑被通缉”。
警探 Kennedy 提供了协助，但被通缉者不在家中，对其房间的搜查也未发现任何共产主义文献。一名华人警探被留在该处，直至1934年2月7日下午3时，届时特别支部从警局撤回了令状，并要求撤回该警探。
法国警察局警探 Kulonay 也于1934年2月5日上午9时35分请求逮捕此人，理由是其在1934年1月30日于法租界袭击了 Jong Moong Yoong。该袭击情节轻微，建议该警探获取逮捕令，但其未再返回。
